steps: Keep failure-specific runDownload filtering available for refusal cases, but make the success case collect the unfiltered MobileWebShellSessionEvent list. Pass an externally held downloads Set to download.

Align the success store fixture commit result with MANIFEST.buildId (currently it returns the short string c despite staging c repeated 64 times), retain directory d and MANIFEST totalBytes=1, and use the existing runtime session s, flow3 and zero elapsed clock.

With the current fetch stub that emits no progress, compare the full event list to download-staged(flow3), then activated(flow3, generationDirectory=d, sessionId=s, buildId=MANIFEST.buildId, totalBytes=1, elapsedMs=0). If adding explicit progress delivery, assert each progress event and its order as well.

Assert downloads.size=0 after completion, and observe the set during the held fetch if proving registration. A no-op download or omitted activated event must fail. Keep separate no-client, fetch-refusal, stage-failure and commit-failure cases 42.6-42.9.

Do not replace the production effect with a helper that manufactures the expected events. This is a direct production download call with controlled transport/store ports, not proof of native disk or live network.

Change cachedStore destructuring to retain fileSystem. Seed the cached generation first, then wrap the existing fileSystem.moveDirectory with a typed delegating recorder; call the original bound method so the real in-memory move and production stage/commit still run.

Record only update-generation movement after the cache seed. Run both existing concurrent downloads against the same real GenerationStore and compare each caller full event sequence: download-staged then activated, with flow3, the exact UPDATE build ID/directory/totalBytes and configured session/time values.

Assert exactly one move from the UPDATE tmp directory into its generations directory, with exact source/destination URIs. Assert final active generation, manifest and app.js reused bytes. Do not assert commitGeneration is called once: two callers may legitimately enter the idempotent commit path.

Preserve 42.11 staging-sweep/reused-byte control. A second physical move or a caller losing its activation result must fail; future mutations to establish this witness require separate authorization. No controller/store production changes are proposed.
